text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: No ntab module or FeatureRef implementation is present in the current build/source inventory. Exact ordered support and metadata-only non-resolution are useful scientific requirements, but this is a new optional integration, not an existing defect. Retain P3 deferred; wait for ntab-0 current frame4s capability review and one native workflow. Reuse current provider-owned volume/index types and SurfaceGeometry rather than assuming the historical names describe current ownership. Start with the single payload kind that consumer needs; qualify ordering, missingness and resource read bounds on JVM/JS before broadening.
